name: enrichr
description: 50 billed Enrichr utilities for AI agents. Validate emails (syntax + MX, not mailbox), parse phones, geolocate IPs, decode JWTs, convert currencies, generate QR codes, count LLM tokens, and more. Launch without a key to browse/signup; verified accounts receive 1,000 free calls/month.
long_description: ENRICHR_API_KEY is optional at launch. Without a key, use list_catalog, signup, recover, and other unauthenticated account/catalog paths first. The signup tool returns the raw key once; email verification unlocks the monthly free allowance and recovery. Configure the returned key and restart the MCP server before using billed utilities. On HTTP 402, if purchases_enabled, call start_checkout and ask the human to open the Stripe URL. Latency is not a published SLO. Email checks are syntax + optional MX, not mailbox/SMTP.
